p: who was made whole and refined
as it is written, “a hundred years,”
and as is written in the holy Zohar.

“And Abraham was old, advanced in days”
that is, in the first three sefiros.
the elder of his house,” etc.,

because he was the servant of the Patriarchs,

p: “And King David was old, advanced in days.”
“May my lord King David live forever.”
it would contradict what actually happened,
to sit on his throne in his place.
And if the intent is the World to Come,
why did they need to bless him with it?
have a share in the World to Come!”
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה כה עַמּוּד א)
“David, King of Israel, lives and endures”
for he was refined in all the attributes
and did not die at all,
but is only like one who sleeps for a time.

rich.text: : זָקֵן זֶה קָנָה שְׁנֵי עוֹלָמוֹת. שְׁלֹשָׁה נִכְתָּרִים בְּזִקְנָה וּבְיָמִים... אַבְרָהָם רֹאשׁ לָאָבוֹת, יְהוֹשֻׁעַ רֹאשׁ לַמַּלְכוּת מִשֵּׁבֶט אֶפְרַיִם... דָּוִד רֹאשׁ לַמַּלְכוּת מִשֵּׁבֶט יְהוּדָה... בָּא בַּיָּמִים... רַבִּי אַבָּא אָמַר בָּא בְּכִפְלוֹן מְפֻלָּשׁ לְחַיֵּי הָעוֹלָם הַבָּא, “‘Old’: this one acquired two worlds. h: Why Joshua's proof is drawn from Amalek

p: why it needed to bring a proof
that he was head of the kingship
"כָּל אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יַמְרֶה אֶת פִּיךָ" וְגוֹמֵר
“Any man who rebels against your word,” etc.,
that he be judged as a rebel against the kingship;
Why then did they need to bring proof
in the lifetime of Moshe Rabbeinu,
It would have been better to cite
that he conquered the whole Land of Israel.

p: that the main thing they proved
is that he is the head of a line,
that he was clarified as bound
to the beginning of the Divine Thought.

as is written in the holy Zohar:
“advanced in days — in the supernal days,”
“advanced in days — through an open gateway
into the life of the World to Come.”
And of David too it is written,
“May my lord King David live forever,”
“David, King of Israel, lives and endures,”
which shows that one was refined
is written of Joshua as well.
bound to the beginning of Thought —
from his being chosen by Moshe Rabbeinu
and Amalek, on the side of the kelipah,
by the hand of Rachel's descendants,
that Joshua, on the side of holiness,
stands against the kelipah of Amalek;

to the beginning of Thought, in holiness.

that he too is head of the kingship

the passage “And Joshua was old,” etc.,
“And it came to pass after many days,” etc.,
“and Joshua was old, advanced in days,”
speaks of the fear of God;
because the two of them are alike:
Abraham is head of the Patriarchs,
and likewise David is head of the kingship
and from his seed will come
who was head of the kingship
and who began the blotting out of Amalek;
who will complete the blotting out of Amalek
